text:
Marta G: AM check-in — quick fleet tally and blockers. What changed overnight?
Devin: AMS(eu-west1) headroom at +8 GPUs (g5x). APAC(ap-southeast1) is -2 due to spot drain last night.
Sam: Canary rollout stuck on step 3, PR #254 needs review from @Devin, blocked on tests failing in jogger pipeline.
Li: Spot-interruption pattern shows spikes around 03:00 UTC, will open follow-up with cloud team. Might need to switch 3 nodes to on-demand.
Devin: Posted quota request for eu-west1 +6 (ticket CLOUD-4321). Can someone sanity-check the numbers? Current per-AZ breakdown:
```
az-a: 4 spare
az-b: 2 spare
az-c: 2 spare
``` 
Marta G: OK, approving CLOUD-4321. @OpsJen can you escalate to our account rep if it doesn't move by EOD?
OpsJen: Yep, I'll escalate if no update in 4 hours. Also will spin 2 prewarm instances in az-a to cover canary traffic.
infra-bot: Deploy succeeded: canary-warmup v2.3 -> 10% traffic (2024-11-07T08:12:03Z)
Sam: FYI the failing test is due to kv-cache eviction change; pushing a hotfix branch now.
Li: If preempts continue, we should run a small DR test: swap 2 lanes to fallback region (us-east1) tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Thoughts?
Devin: +1 for DR test, please add to calendar and notify SRE.
Marta G: Summary: approve quota, ops escalate, Sam to merge hotfix, DR test scheduled. If anything blows up ping #oncall. :thumbsup:
Sam: will ping when PR is green.
OpsJen: Created CLOUD-4321 escalation thread and DMed rep. :email:
Marta G: thanks team — check back here with any updates before noon.
